categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds unit and P2P test coverage for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE.
categories.rationale: Adds deterministic unit and P2P test coverage for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE, where previously 'removing the check would pass all tests.' While valuable for guarding against regressions in deserialization limits and stabilizing coverage reports, testing an existing safety check is reasonably deferrable.
